movelist.name: Growl
movelist.effect: Growl lowers all Legal Targets Attack 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Natural Gift
movelist.effect: Refer to the Move Keywords Berry list. Natural Gift deals damage according to the Berry list and Natural Gift’s Type is also defined there. The Berry’s Digestion Buff is nullified and is not used.

movelist.name: Mist
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Mist may activate it when having Combat Stages lowered by any effect; if they do, those Combat Stages are instead not lowered. Mist may be activated 3 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Astonish
movelist.effect: Astonish Flinches the target on 15+. Once per scene, if the target is unaware of the user’s presence, Astonish automatically Flinches the target.

movelist.name: Bubble
movelist.effect: Bubble lowers the target’s Speed on 16+.

movelist.name: Mega Drain
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

abilities.name: Swift Swim
abilities.effect: While in Rainy Weather or under 50% Max Hit Points, the user’s Initiative is doubled.

abilities.name: Own Tempo
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Confusion. Defensive.
